To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

globalization and local practices create “hybrid” outcomes that are both “generic” and unique, that the paradoxes of place are created by both global and local processes, and that globalization processes and local practices are mutually constitutive.
Memphis has become a paradox of place in that it is simultaneously an impoverished city and a city of global power and influence.
Memphis is a global city in which local and global processes and practices coexist and interact, and that the paradoxes of place are a product of these processes and practices.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the paradoxes of place that result when local places are simultaneously shaped by global processes and are sites of resistance to them.
the paradoxes of place in the context of global processes and the impact of these paradoxes on poverty and power.
how globalization is experienced in Memphis, how globalization is shaped by local actors and local practices, and how the paradoxes of globalization and place are manifested and negotiated.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
globalization processes are not generic, and that the outcomes are paradoxical, complex, and unpredictable.
the city of Memphis has been a major player in the world economy, but the city is not the same as the region.
Memphis is a place of paradoxes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
globalization is not a single, coherent process but rather a set of interrelated and sometimes conflicting processes.
Memphis is a place where the paradoxes of globalization are most evident.
globalization processes have created paradoxes of place in Memphis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
globalization is a process that is not simply imposed from the top down, nor is it simply a matter of local adaptation to global pressures.
globalization processes are not generic, but rather are locally embedded, locally produced, and locally contested.
globalization and local place are mutually constitutive.
